title: Implement provider-native tool calling for Ollama and GitHub Models with fallback
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 2.2. Current tool invocation relies on text JSON extraction only. Add provider-native structured tool calling for providers that support it, preserve current text parsing as fallback, and include compatibility tests to prevent regression for legacy models.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body:
## Evidence Update

- Summary: Implemented provider-native tool registration and native tool-call normalization for Ollama with deterministic JSON-text fallback preserved.
- Changed files:
  - `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs`
  - `MemorySmith.Tests/PagesAndChatTests.cs`
- Validation commands:
  - `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter Name~ChatProviders_ReportCapabilityMetadata|Name~OllamaChatProvider_IncludesNativeToolDefinitionsWhenProvided|Name~OllamaChatProvider_ConvertsNativeToolCallsIntoFallbackEnvelope|Name~OllamaChatProvider_StreamsLiveChunks|Name~MemoryChatAgent_StreamsToolCallStatusWithoutLeakingToolJson`
- Validation results:
  - 5 passed, 0 failed
- Confidence: 88%
- Open questions:
  - GitHub SDK path still lacks stable app-supplied native tool registration surface; evaluate reflective/event-based native call extraction versus keeping JSON-text fallback as canonical.
- Note: MCP task API calls were attempted first per skill contract but are blocked by 401 Missing/invalid X-Api-Key, so this update is recorded via local task JSON fallback.
